data.description: You alter multiple creatures so the touch of the sun is hostile to them. The cursed creatures gain light blindness and are blinded for 1 round if exposed to bright light, such as sunlight or the daylight spell. The cursed creatures are dazzled as long as they remains in areas of bright light, and they are treated as being particularly susceptible to sunlight for the purposes of resolving spells like searing light, sunbeam, and sunburst.
